description: This Java interface 'Signal' defines a generic base for service messages that convey actions, notices, or warnings. It extends multiple interfaces and provides a method to retrieve the signal's name based on its type.

classes.name: Signal
classes.description: A generic interface for service messages that instruct action or communicate notices, with methods for accessing message properties such as name, type, id, and resource.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the signal, derived from its type. If the type contains a colon, it returns the substring after the colon; otherwise, it returns the type itself.
